Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.hokob.label: On 'Apollo and Marsyas'
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.hokob.startdescription: 'Delicious. I can be certain now of a generous and memorable feast. You might yet prove more useful than your predecessors.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.hokob.label: On the 'Invisible Opera'
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.hokob.startdescription: 'Adequate. I hope this will not be your last adequacy. We wouldn't want a Librarian to go unpaid, now, would we?'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.hokob.label: On the Unfinished Lark
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.hokob.startdescription: 'Yes; yes, that will be sufficient. Don't fret, Librarian, here is your little gratuity.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.hokob.label: On the Royal Endeavour
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.hokob.startdescription: 'Yes, this has been quite satisfactory, especially considering the sad state of affairs which persists in this House. I make no complaint; good day.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.hokob.label: On the Threshold Revolution
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.hokob.startdescription: 'I was right - again. I must move quickly… oh, I suppose you'll want paying…'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.morge.label: On the Claw and the Clouds
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.morge.startdescription: 'I begin to form a conception… we will see. And perhaps, my Librarian, you should observe also the clouds above Brancrug.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.morge.label: On 'Apollo and Marsyas'
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.morge.startdescription: 'Choice, and rare! Oh ho ho, I had hoped for this exactly. Thank you, my Librarian.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.morge.label: On 'Apollo and Marsyas'
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.morge.startdescription: 'This is not what I had expected, but if it had, it would not be inspiration, no? Thank you, my Librarian.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.morge.label: On the 'Invisible Opera'
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.morge.startdescription: 'Earth is thicker than blood - isn't that what our little Thérèse says? Well, my Librarian, we shall see. À bientôt.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.morge.label: On the Unfinished Lark
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.morge.startdescription: 'This is what I need. It is always such a pity, the end of an artist. Let us hope he did not die in vain.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.morge.label: On the Threshold Revolution
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.morge.startdescription: 'Librarian - my little Librarian - I must thank you. So much. I know exactly who to find. Please, take this! You deserve more. But I shall spare you my kiss, hey?'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.numa..label: On the Counterfeit Memory
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.numa..startdescription: 'Yes, dear. If we don't know what we've lost when we've buried it, we won't know it until they've buried us. I would think about what I'm ready to bury, if I were you. Sleep softly.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.numa..label: On the Midnight Twin
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.numa..startdescription: 'Yes, dear. Without all those gods in darkness, I don't imagine we'd see much Sun anywhere below Eternity. Sleep softly.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.numa..label: On Knot and Tangle
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.numa..startdescription: 'Yes, dear. No paper without trees; no forest without the axe; no loss without memory. Sleep softly.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.numa..label: On the Sanctuary Draught
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.numa..startdescription: '…count on a poet to…charlatan. Our daughter…'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.numa..label: On the Feasting Few
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.numa..startdescription: '…once we've begun, there's no end to it. Without the Grail, no Intercalate; without the Intercalate, how would the Hours keep from…'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.numa..label: On Knot and Tangle
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.numa..startdescription: '…optimism? If you term it that! I do not deny the Hours. But who else than we would make these Histories, in the face of all the Glory's lights, if…'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.numa..label: On the Counterfeit Memory
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.numa..startdescription: '…Ys, the exception, but no exception to Eternity can last forever. That's rather the point! Only when I accepted that…'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.numa..label: On the Midnight Twin
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.numa..startdescription: '…my arrogance, fought to overthrow Necessity. I will not say my time was wasted - no blow struck against tyranny is wasted. But only when I saw…'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.numa..label: On the Softer Frost
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.numa..startdescription: '...endings like the pale light before a pale dawn. We can always be certain of a first time - we can never be certain when it is the last…'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.numa..label: On the Sanctuary Draught
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.numa..startdescription: 'If I were here, this would comfort me; if I were here, I would reward you better than now I do.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.numa..label: On the Feasting Few
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.numa..startdescription: 'Blood is significant; choices, infinitely more so. My descendant-child has her own choices to make. If I were here, I would ask you to give her my counsel… but I cannot be here.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.numa..label: On the Softer Frost
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.numa..startdescription: 'When I was here - when I came here, the first time - I was so angry. That I had been cast aside after I opened the way - that was the least of it. That I had opened the way - that was the worst of it. Though, once, I thought it was the other way around.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.numa..label: On Knot and Tangle
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.numa..startdescription: 'When I was here - the first time - the first sacrifice I made was to the Grail. Without that, there would be no Hush House at all. Oh, the covenant-stone, the tree, all that, perhaps. But remember that it all begins with birth.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.olymp.label: On the Oriflamme Heist
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.olymp.startdescription: 'Curious indeed. This has given me more than enough to work with, Librarian. Thank you.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.olymp.label: On the Dappled Rose
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.olymp.startdescription: 'Thank you. I have enough to make a start. I really don't want to go all that way to Miah myself - it's not so very exceptional a story! - but I think I might know someone who can help. Again, thank you.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.olymp.label: On the 'Invisible Opera'
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.olymp.startdescription: 'I've found a few things. Perhaps they'll be enough. Everything fails until it succeeds, does it not, Librarian? Thank you.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.olymp.label: On the Unfinished Lark
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.olymp.startdescription: 'This may be enough. I hope that will be enough. Thank you, Librarian.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.olymp.label: On the Royal Endeavour
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.olymp.startdescription: 'Truly it might mean a Second Dawn. Or a war. I would prefer the Dawn. But then it might be both… thank you, Librarian. Keep my visit between us two only, for now, if you don't mind.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.seren.label: On the Oriflamme Heist
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.seren.startdescription: 'Thank you. I have a meeting there next week, with someone I think I can trust. And now, I hope, I have enough material for him to take me seriously.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.seren.label: On the Particular Mystique
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.seren.startdescription: 'I don't believe there's anything here. When times grow strange, people turn to religion. I think that's really all it is. Thank you for setting my mind at ease.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.seren.label: On the Unfettered Eye
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.seren.startdescription: 'I should have learned by now not to jump to conclusions. It's not a Watchman-name at all. I think it just might be a Name of the Chandler. I had heard there was one out in the world causing mischief… of course I'll have to make sure. Thank you.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.seren.label: On the Unfinished Lark
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.seren.startdescription: 'I think - I think - Zidane might have been using Ys-metal in his work. That would upset quite a number of people, from the Bureau on down…. thank you, Librarian. I hope I can always trust you to keep our conversations confidential.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.seren.label: On the Royal Endeavour
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.seren.startdescription: 'My concerns remain. You've heard of the Sunset Road? The alchemies of the House of Lancaster? I find similarities in this Endeavour of the King's. We don't want any more Sovereigns of the Leashed Flame, do we? Let's leave all that medieval nonsense in the Middle Ages. Thank you for your help.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.seren.label: On the Royal Endeavour
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.seren.startdescription: 'My concerns remain. This is a Solar project, no doubt of it. Everything is doctrinally acceptable… everything goes back to Light… but this sunset business. You know, I have always believed the Chandler to be Sunset Celia's. No, it shouldn't be possible, but the Chandler shouldn't be possible either. Keep this to yourself. Thank you.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.stani.label: On the Grunewald Provision
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.stani.startdescription: 'Thank you, Librarian. I should be able now to discourage the thing from taking midnight constitutionals. It's bad enough when it does that in my rooms. It would be very rude so to inconvenience other passengers if I have to travel by train.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.stani.label: On the God in the Wood
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.stani.startdescription: 'I'm going to speak to some of these people. I have felt for a while that something is changing in the tempo of the world's pulse.  I think this may be an opportunity for me to understand what.  I might be wrong. It's been known. But thank you, Librarian, please take my blessing; and this.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.stani.label: On the God in the Wood
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.stani.startdescription: 'I'm going to the Black Forest. I think this is something I'll need to follow down into the roots. I think there is an opportunity here, for something old to be reborn in the right way or the wrong one.  I might be wrong. It's been known. But thank you, Librarian, please take my blessing; and this.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.stani.label: On the Sandalwood Saint
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.stani.startdescription: 'Best to bury it. I suspect it may be a seed of sorts. If so, let it grow. It will take its time. 'To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the earth.' I'll pass on my recommendations.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.stani.label: On the Friar's Tapestry
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.stani.startdescription: 'You know I had to manage Galmier's reincorporation, up in the mountains by the Grove? I wish I'd known these techniques back then. It was the most difficult thing I've ever done. And I think she'll most likely return to the Mansus anyway. (Although, at least, I can tease her that she smells of humus.)'
